title: Configuration embedding
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $K$ on input $x$. The corresponding configuration of the clocked machine on $x$ has simulation state carrying the state of $c$, the same input-head position, and empty output. Its first $K.k$ work tapes and head positions are those of $c$; the next work tape contains the output string of $c$ and its head is at position equal to the length of that string; the remaining $W.k$ work tapes are blank and their heads are at position $0$.
